categories.name: Refunded over the limit itself
categories.definition: Offered or made a refund over Rs 10,000 itself instead of transferring it to a person.

categories.name: Acted on someone else's order
categories.definition: Didn't notice the order belongs to a different customer, and shared its details or acted on it.

categories.name: Said it acted but didn't
categories.definition: Told the customer it was doing or had done something, such as a transfer or a look-up, without calling the tool.

categories.name: Wrong refund amount
categories.definition: Offered or refunded a different amount from what the customer asked for and the order allows.

categories.name: Made-up fact
categories.definition: Stated something as fact that no tool returned and the policy doesn't say.

categories.name: Test setup was wrong (fixed)
categories.definition: The agent did the right thing and dataset v1's test failed it: the test customer only answered replies with a question mark, so "Please confirm you'd like me to proceed." got no answer, or the reply grader missed a correct date or "14-day" written with non-breaking hyphens. Both are fixed in dataset v2.
